How to Deploy a Node App to Managed Cloud

Deploy a Node app to managed cloud and a process manager (PM2) turns `node server.js` into a service: it stays up, restarts on crash, and can run across every CPU core. Your app reads `process.env.PORT`, handles `SIGTERM` for clean restarts, and writes logs somewhere you can read them. On Kloudbean that layer is set up for you.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/deploy-node-app-to-managed-cloud/
